content.what_it_is: MATLAB script that loads a depth/peak-frequency file and discrete wind-wave frequency, angle, and Hmo components (lines 6-30), converts Hmo to amplitudes and assigns reproducible random phases (lines 31-40), forms every pairwise difference-frequency infragravity component using a second-order interaction coefficient (lines 42-77), concatenates IG and wind-wave components into a FUNWAVE spectral input file (lines 79-106), and plots wind-wave, IG, and combined elevation time series (lines 109-144).

equations.ref: convert component Hmo values to amplitudes
significant height from summed spectral energy

unresolved: The script explicitly loads SPC_angle.txt at line 29 but never uses angle; it hard-codes Dire=0.0 at line 93. Thus the advertised single input angle at line 9 is silently discarded from the generated FUNWAVE spectrum.

The header documents spectrum_random_phase.txt at line 12, while the actual output is spectrum_two_components.txt at line 88; downstream instructions using the documented name will not find the produced file.

The plotted IG reconstruction adds freq_low directly as a phase term at line 116, whereas the generated-file reconstruction at line 119 uses only Phase1 and the exported IG phases at lines 96 and 104 contain phase_low without freq_low. The diagnostic blue IG trace therefore does not represent the spectral file that the script writes.

The Dnm expression divides by omega(1)*omega(2) and by g*knm*tanh(knm*h)-(omega(1)-omega(2))^2 at lines 64-66 without checking zero-frequency inputs, duplicate frequencies (knm=fnm=0), or a difference-frequency free-wave resonance. A zero or near-zero denominator propagates Inf/NaN into anm at line 68 and the output at line 103.

Eng1, lambda, Knm, OMEGA_nm, fre_used, and spc_used are computed at lines 59, 71-75, and 95 but never consumed; in particular Eng1 is not the quantity written, so the output contains amplitudes despite a separately constructed energy representation.
